title: Three Saturdays and One Short Hook
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：lamb　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lamb 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the butcher ① weighed the lamb that no neighbour in the market would have recorded, and he said the weighing was the whole of the Saturday. The ② lamb, meaning the joint itself and not the hook, ran three Saturdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lamb, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lamb in that market had the same short hook beside it, and the ④ lamb at the far stall, meaning the cut they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lamb, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the butcher said the recording is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lamb was the whole of the matter, meaning the tenderness and not the joint. The ⑥ lamb, meaning the tenderness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lamb, he said, is either something you weigh or the only word that means both a joint and a tenderness. He said the tenderness is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ lamb had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short hook. The ⑧ lamb of the whole thing, the butcher wrote in November, was one market and three Saturdays of recording; lamb, he said, is either the cut at the far stall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lamb I remember is the joint recorded in the bill, which closed in 1975 and is still recorded as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ lamb, my mother said in 1977, is the only joint that improves by being recorded; every lamb, she said, is a tenderness that has agreed to look like a joint. She said the tenderness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 羔羊；羔羊肉（指集市里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 羔羊；羔羊肉（指那只羊羔本身，与挂钩相对）
C. 固定搭配：weigh the lamb 称量这只羔羊
D. n. 羔羊；羔羊肉（指留给孩子们提回去的那一块那一只）
E. n. 庖厨之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的羔羊之事）
F. n. 羔羊；羔羊肉（指账单里写到、被记载的的那一只）
G. n. 鲜嫩、温情（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 温情（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: weighed the lamb that no neighbour in the market would have recorded
The lamb, meaning the joint itself and not the hook
the lamb at the far stall
the lamb was the whole of the matter
the lamb had become a line in a bill
The lamb of the whole thing
A lamb, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: weigh the lamb 意为“称量这只羔羊”，1968 年那位屠户把集市里没有一位邻居肯记载的一只羔羊做了一遍。
lamb 意为“羔羊；羔羊肉”，指那只羊羔本身而不是挂钩，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被记载。
lamb 意为“羔羊；羔羊肉”，指集市里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一个小小的挂钩。
lamb 意为“羔羊；羔羊肉”，指最远那个摊位留给孩子们提回去的那一块那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lamb 意为“鲜嫩、温情”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份鲜嫩就是那件事的全部。
lamb 意为“温情”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只羊羔，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lamb 意为“羔羊；羔羊肉”，指账单里写到、被记载的的那一只，到 1973 年这一只成了账单里的一行。
lamb 意为“庖厨之事”，屠户十一月写道，整件事的羔羊之事是一处集市和三个星期六的记载。
lamb 意为“羔羊；羔羊肉”，我记得的是账单里记载过的那一只，1975 年称好了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一只。
lamb 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，羔羊是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的羊羔。
